assurance_choice: Add thin transparent capture only as an explicit assurance property; ordinary writes remain authoritative, no required mutation IR.
substrate_default: Do not rebuild generic compiled substrate by default.
conditional_build: For a known large/repeated-workbook-read tail matching the measured resource, a minimal Candidate-A index + narrow A1 + fail-closed/freshness guards is justified conditionally. Charge all construction, maintenance and hardening costs together.
decision_evidence: Mean-based checkpoint gross ~84s > ~25.9s build/maintenance; median ~19s < ~25.9s. Existing evidence supports tail-dependent value, not broadly self-funding rebuild.
capture_dependency: Capture assurance does not itself justify a compiled index.
freshness_dependency: No compiled serving => no independent compiled freshness infrastructure.
helper_choice: Optional same helper surface can use ordinary openpyxl if product need warrants; no substrate justification.
omit: generic compiled substrate without workload case
no_circularity: A conditional speedup alone does not justify substrate; assess measured savings minus shared full costs, once.
